name: sed
description: Stream editor for filtering and transforming text

name: -n
--quiet
--silent
options.description: Suppress automatic printing of pattern space

name: -e
--expression
options.description: Add the script to the commands to be executed

name: -f
--file
options.description: Add the contents of script-file to the commands to be executed

options.name: --follow-symlinks
options.description: Follow symlinks when processing in place

name: -i
--in-place
options.description: Edit files in place (makes backup if SUFFIX supplied)

name: -l
--line-length
options.description: Specify the desired line-wrap length for the `l' command

name: -E
-r
--regexp-extended
options.description: Use extended regular expressions in the script

name: -s
--separate
options.description: Consider files as separate rather than as a single

options.name: --sandbox
options.description: Operate in sandbox mode (disable e/r/w commands)

name: -u
--unbuffered
options.description: Load minimal amounts of data from the input files and flush
